answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable bond locked until dawn of the next epoch, like a marble set into a shared knoll of collateral: new identities start with zero trust and earn reputation only through verified work attested by independent peers. If an identity is caught duplicating work or voting twice, its bond is slashed and its reputation burned. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund thousands of bonds and lose them all on detection, making sybil attacks cost far more than any reward they could extract.
